name: Family Reunification Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Eligible family members are the sponsor's spouse (18+), the minor children of the sponsor and/or spouse (including adopted), and other minor dependent children where the sponsor/spouse has custody. Reunification of a second spouse under polygamous marriage is prohibited.
The sponsor must have lawfully resided in Greece for at least 2 years before family members can be sponsored.
requirements.fix_path: Wait until the sponsor reaches 2 years of lawful residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Sponsor must show steady, regular annual income (not social assistance) at least equal to the annual wage of an unskilled worker, increased by 20% for a spouse and 15% for each child (the 15% child increase is waived if both spouses already lawfully reside in Greece and are reuniting with their own children).
Sponsor must maintain full health insurance covering all risks at the level provided to Greek nationals, for themselves and reunited family members.

evidence_required.document: Recent civil status certificate (marriage/birth) from foreign authorities, certified and translated, issued within 6 months

outcome.duration_length: variable, tied to the sponsor's own permit duration

sources.title: Greek Ministry of Foreign Affairs -- Codification of Legislation, Articles 53-54 (family reunification: eligible members, sponsor's 2-year residence, income and insurance requirements)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Greece's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1 via the MFA's own codification document, with exact article numbers and the income formula. work_rights set to 'restricted' as a conservative default (family reunification permits commonly carry conditional/derivative work access in many jurisdictions) -- this specific point was not explicitly confirmed either way in the fetched excerpt, flagged here rather than asserted as 'full' or 'none' without a source. A separate, more generous family-reunification track exists for recognized refugees (per UNHCR Greece) that was not modelled as its own file in this pass -- refugees' family reunification rights are referenced in gr_international_protection's outcome instead.
